title: Bride of Deimos — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
The story Bride of Deimos tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Bride of Deimos (Japanese: 悪魔(デイモス)の花嫁, Hepburn: Deimosu no Hanayome) is a Japanese dark fantasy manga series written by Etsuko Ikeda and illustrated by Yuuho Ashibe. It premiered in Princess magazine in December 1974, later moving to Viva Princess, where it ran until the magazine became defunct with the release of its October 1990 issue.

Strip Bride of Deimos of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. Minako ends up in the crossfire of this feud when she visits the mansion and catches the eye of the brother. Jason Thompson of Anime News Network described Bride of Deimos as a "funky mixture of gory horror and mythology, of Buddhism, Christianity, and Greek myth", with "enjoyable old-school shojo manga artwork".
